articles.summary: Kodiak AI partners with Roush to scale upfitting of autonomous trucks, enabling broader deployment of Kodiak Driver-powered vehicles starting in late 2025.
articles.title: Kodiak Selects Roush as Manufacturing Partner to Upfit Kodiak Driver-Equipped Trucks

articles.summary: Kodiak AI has delivered two more autonomous trucks to Atlas Energy Solutions, expanding its fleet to four and launching up to 24/7 driverless service in the Permian Basin.
articles.title: Kodiak Announces Delivery of Two Additional Customer-Owned and -Operated Driverless Trucks to Atlas; Launches Driverless Service Up To 24/7
